title: Optimizing Nitrogen Use Efficiency in Precision Rice Farming Systems
authors: Dr. Praveen Kumar, Dr. Abhishek Raj
abstract: Nitrogen use efficiency (NUE) remains a key bottleneck in maximizing grain yields while minimizing environmental nitrogen losses. This study evaluates a sensor-based precision application framework for nitrogen management in lowland rice. Results show a 15% increase in NUE and a 12% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions compared to traditional blanket applications.
